name: @pipeworx/mcp-companies-house

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search UK Companies House by company name. Returns matches with company number, name, status (active/dissolved), type, registered office address, and incorporation date. Use the company_number to look up officers, filings, and PSCs.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Fetch a single UK company profile by company number. Returns registered name, status, type, SIC codes, registered office, accounts/confirmation-statement due dates, and links to officers/filings/charges/PSCs.

tools.name: get_officers
tools.description: List directors, secretaries, or LLP members for a UK company by company_number (from search_companies). Returns each officer's name, role, appointment/resignation dates, occupation, nationality, country of residence, and date of birth (month/year). Supports register_type filter (directors | secretaries | llp-members) and pagination.

company_number.description: UK company number (e.g. "07098618") OR the company NAME (e.g. "Ocado Group") — a name is resolved here automatically and the match is echoed back as resolved_from_name. Pass whichever you have; do not guess a number from memory, since a plausible wrong one returns a clean officer list for a different company.

tools.name: get_filings
tools.description: Retrieve filing history for a UK company by company_number (from search_companies). Returns up to 25 filings per page — each with category, type, description, filing date, action date, transaction ID, page count, and document metadata URL. Filter by category (accounts | confirmation-statement | officers | etc.).

company_number.description: UK company number (e.g. "07098618") OR the company NAME (e.g. "Ocado Group") — a name is resolved here automatically and the match is echoed back as resolved_from_name. Pass whichever you have; do not guess a number from memory, since a plausible wrong one returns a clean empty result that reads as "nothing filed" for a company that may not exist.

tools.name: get_persons_with_significant_control
tools.description: Retrieve PSC (beneficial owner) records for a UK company by company_number (from search_companies). Returns each PSC's name, kind (individual-person / corporate-entity / legal-person), natures of control (e.g. ownership-of-shares-75-to-100-percent), country of residence, nationality, notification date, and ceased date.

company_number.description: UK company number (e.g. "07098618") OR the company NAME (e.g. "Ocado Group") — a name is resolved here automatically and the match is echoed back as resolved_from_name. Pass whichever you have; do not guess a number from memory, since a plausible wrong one returns a clean empty result that reads as "nothing filed" for a company that may not exist.

tools.name: get_charges
tools.description: Retrieve the charges register for a UK company by company_number (from search_companies) OR company NAME — secured lending (mortgages, debentures, fixed/floating charges) registered against the company, the UK analogue of a US UCC lien filing. Returns each charge's charge_number, classification/description, status (outstanding | satisfied | part-satisfied | fully-satisfied), created_on/delivered_on/satisfied_on dates, particulars (fixed/floating/negative-pledge flags and amount secured where stated), and persons_entitled (the lender(s) secured by the charge). A company with no secured lending on file returns zero charges, which reads differently from a company_number that does not exist — this call disambiguates between the two the same way get_filings does. Counts (total/outstanding/satisfied/part-satisfied) are returned ahead of the charge list.

company_number.description: UK company number (e.g. "07098618") OR the company NAME (e.g. "Ocado Group") — a name is resolved here automatically and the match is echoed back as resolved_from_name. Pass whichever you have; do not guess a number from memory, since a plausible wrong one returns a clean empty result that reads as "no charges" for a company that may not exist.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-companies-house forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the companies-house pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
